newsitem.title: USA: Group Technologies gets $4.3 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Group Technologies gets $4.3 mln contract.

text.p: Group Technologies Corp said Friday it has been awarded a new contract for $4.3 million by Litton Data Systems to manufacture electronic circuit card assemblies.

"We are pleased with the confidence that Litton has expressed by selecting us as a significant supplier to this program." said Thomas Lovelock, President and Chief Executive of Group Technologies. "Being part of Litton's contribution to military modernization is important to GTC's long term involvement and growth in government programs through its Federal Systems Group."
